Funding Requirements. - The DBM shall source out funds for the

Separability Clause. - Any portion or provision of this Executive Order
that may be declared unconstitutional shall not have the effect or nullifying other portions
and provisions of the Order for as long as such remaining portions can still subsist and be
given effect.

Repealing Clause. - All executive orders, rules, regulations and other
issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of the Executive
Order are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. - This Order shall take effect immediately upon approval.
